english: What has helped you stay safe so far?
transliteration: Jigeumkkaji anjeonhage jinaeneun de mueosi doumi dwaennayo?
translation: 지금까지 안전하게 지내는 데 무엇이 도움이 됐나요?

english: Is there someone you trust whom we can contact?
transliteration: Jeohiga yeollakhaedo gwaenchaneun, mideul su inneun buni gyesingayo?
translation: 저희가 연락해도 괜찮은, 믿을 수 있는 분이 계신가요?

english: I am concerned about your safety and want to help you stay safe.
transliteration: Hwanjabun-ui anjeoni geokjeongdwaeseo anjeonhage jinaesil su itdorok dopgo sipeoyo.
translation: 환자분의 안전이 걱정돼서 안전하게 지내실 수 있도록 돕고 싶어요.

english: Do you feel safe where you live?
Has anyone threatened or hurt you?
transliteration: Nugunga wihyeophageona dachige han jeogi innayo?
translation: 누군가 위협하거나 다치게 한 적이 있나요?

english: Are you afraid of anyone at home?
transliteration: Jibe inneun saram jung duryeoun sarami innayo?
translation: 집에 있는 사람 중 두려운 사람이 있나요?

english: Have you had thoughts of hurting someone else?
transliteration: Dareun sarameul haechigo sipdaneun saenggageul hasin jeogi innayo?
translation: 다른 사람을 해치고 싶다는 생각을 하신 적이 있나요?

english: Is there a particular person you are thinking about hurting?
transliteration: Haechigo sipdago saenggakhaneun teukjeonghan sarami innayo?
translation: 해치고 싶다고 생각하는 특정한 사람이 있나요?

english: Do you have a plan to hurt anyone?
Are there children or other vulnerable people at home?
transliteration: Jibe eorinina dareun doumi piryohan buni gyesingayo?
translation: 집에 어린이나 다른 도움이 필요한 분이 계신가요?

english: Have you experienced something frightening or traumatic?
transliteration: Duryeopgeona chunggyeokjeogin ireul gyeokkeusin jeogi innayo?
translation: 두렵거나 충격적인 일을 겪으신 적이 있나요?

english: You do not have to share details before you are ready.
transliteration: Junbiga doegi jeoneneun jasehi malsseumhaji aneusyeodo dwaeyo.
translation: 준비가 되기 전에는 자세히 말씀하지 않으셔도 돼요.

english: Do memories of that experience come back unexpectedly?
Do you have nightmares about what happened?
transliteration: Museun iri isseonneunjie daehan angmong-eul kkusinayo?
translation: 무슨 일이 있었는지에 대한 악몽을 꾸시나요?

english: Do you avoid reminders of what happened?
transliteration: Geu iri saenggangnage haneun geoseul pihasinayo?
translation: 그 일이 생각나게 하는 것을 피하시나요?

english: Do you feel constantly on guard or unsafe?
Do you sometimes feel disconnected from yourself or your surroundings?
transliteration: Ttaettaero jasini-na jubyeongwa dongtteoreojin neukkimi deusinayo?
translation: 때때로 자신이나 주변과 동떨어진 느낌이 드시나요?

english: Do you drink alcohol?
How often and how much do you drink?
transliteration: Sureun eolmana jaju, eolmana mani deuseyo?
translation: 술은 얼마나 자주, 얼마나 많이 드세요?

english: Have you wanted to cut down on drinking?
transliteration: Sureul jurigo sipdago saenggakhasin jeogi isseuseyo?
translation: 술을 줄이고 싶다고 생각하신 적이 있으세요?

english: Has anyone expressed concern about your drinking?
transliteration: Jubyeoneseo sureul neomu mani masindago geokjeonghan jeogi innayo?
translation: 주변에서 술을 너무 많이 마신다고 걱정한 적이 있나요?

english: Do you use cannabis?
Do you use cocaine, opioids, or other drugs?
Have you ever injected drugs?
When did you last use alcohol or other substances?
transliteration: Surina dareun muljireul majimageuro sayonghan ge eonjeingayo?
translation: 술이나 다른 물질을 마지막으로 사용한 게 언제인가요?

english: Do you feel shaky or unwell when you stop using them?
transliteration: Surina dareun muljireul kkeunheumyeon momi tteolligeona momi an joeuseyo?
translation: 술이나 다른 물질을 끊으면 몸이 떨리거나 몸이 안 좋으세요?

english: Have you ever had a seizure during withdrawal?
transliteration: Geumdan jeungsangeuro baljageul han jeogi isseuseyo?
translation: 금단 증상으로 발작을 한 적이 있으세요?

english: Would you like support to reduce or stop using substances?
transliteration: Muljil sayongeul jurigeona kkeunneun de doumeul batgo sipeuseyo?
translation: 물질 사용을 줄이거나 끊는 데 도움을 받고 싶으세요?

english: How do you feel about your eating habits?
Do you worry a lot about your weight or body shape?
Have you been skipping meals or restricting food?
Do you sometimes feel unable to stop eating?
transliteration: Gakkeum meongneun geoseul meomchul su eopdago neukkiseyo?
translation: 가끔 먹는 것을 멈출 수 없다고 느끼세요?

english: Have you made yourself vomit after eating?
transliteration: Meogeun dwie ilbureo tohan jeogi isseuseyo?
translation: 먹은 뒤에 일부러 토한 적이 있으세요?

english: Have you been exercising to compensate for eating?
transliteration: Meogeun geoseul manhoeharyeogo undonghasin jeogi isseuseyo?
translation: 먹은 것을 만회하려고 운동하신 적이 있으세요?

english: Have you had trouble paying attention?
Do you often forget appointments or tasks?
Have you noticed changes in your memory?
Do you find it difficult to organize tasks?
Have you been feeling confused?
Has anyone noticed a change in your behaviour?
transliteration: Jubyeoneseo haengdongi dallajyeotdago han jeogi innayo?
translation: 주변에서 행동이 달라졌다고 한 적이 있나요?

english: Can you tell me your full name?
Can you tell me today’s date?
Can you tell me where we are right now?
I will say three words; please repeat them.
transliteration: Jega daneo se gaereul malhalgeyo. Ttara hae juseyo.
translation: 제가 단어 세 개를 말할게요. 따라 해 주세요.

english: Please try to remember those words for later.
transliteration: Najunge dasi malsseumhasil su itge i daneodeureul gieokhae juseyo.
translation: 나중에 다시 말씀하실 수 있게 이 단어들을 기억해 주세요.

english: Can you tell me those three words now?
transliteration: Geu se daneoreul jigeum malsseumhae jusigesseoyo?
translation: 그 세 단어를 지금 말씀해 주시겠어요?

english: Can you spell a word backwards?
transliteration: Daneo hanareul geokkuro cheoljadaero malsseumhae jusigesseoyo?
translation: 단어 하나를 거꾸로 철자대로 말씀해 주시겠어요?

english: What do you think is causing these difficulties?
transliteration: Ireon eoryeoumi saenggineun iyuga mworago saenggakhaseyo?
translation: 이런 어려움이 생기는 이유가 뭐라고 생각하세요?

english: How would you describe your mood today?

stage: Past history, family and social support
english: Have you ever seen a psychiatrist or counsellor?
transliteration: Jeongsingwa uisana sangdamsareul mannan jeogi isseuseyo?
translation: 정신과 의사나 상담사를 만난 적이 있으세요?

stage: Past history, family and social support
english: Have you ever been admitted to hospital for mental health care?
transliteration: Jeongsingeongang chiryoreul wihae byeongwone ibwonhan jeogi isseuseyo?
translation: 정신건강 치료를 위해 병원에 입원한 적이 있으세요?

stage: Past history, family and social support
english: Has anyone in your family had mental health difficulties?
transliteration: Gajok junge jeongsingeongang munjereul gyeokkeun buni isseuseyo?
translation: 가족 중에 정신건강 문제를 겪은 분이 있으세요?

stage: Past history, family and social support
english: Do you have any medical conditions?

stage: Past history, family and social support
english: Who do you live with?

stage: Past history, family and social support
english: Who can you turn to for support?
transliteration: Doumi piryo hal ttae uijihal su inneun buni nuguseyo?
translation: 도움이 필요할 때 의지할 수 있는 분이 누구세요?

stage: Past history, family and social support
english: Have you had recent financial or housing difficulties?
transliteration: Choegune gyeongjejeok eoryeoumina jugeo munjega isseosyeosseoyo?
translation: 최근에 경제적 어려움이나 주거 문제가 있으셨어요?

stage: Past history, family and social support
english: Are your relationships causing you stress?
What medicines are you taking now?
Do you take antidepressant medication?
Do you take medicine for anxiety?
Do you take antipsychotic medication?
Do you take a mood stabilizer?
Do you take sleeping pills or benzodiazepines?
What dose do you take and how often?
transliteration: Han beone eolmana deusigo, eolmana jaju deuseyo?
translation: 한 번에 얼마나 드시고, 얼마나 자주 드세요?

english: How long have you been taking this medicine?
transliteration: I yageul deusin ji eolmana doesyeosseoyo?
translation: 이 약을 드신 지 얼마나 되셨어요?

english: Have you missed any doses recently?
Has the medicine been helping?
Have you noticed any side effects?
Have you stopped any medication recently?
What are your goals for treatment?
transliteration: Chiryoreul tonghae eotteon mokpyoreul irugo sipeuseyo?
translation: 치료를 통해 어떤 목표를 이루고 싶으세요?

english: Would you be interested in talking therapy or counselling?
We can discuss medication options together.
transliteration: Yangmul chiryo seontaekjireul hamkke sanguihal su isseoyo.
translation: 약물 치료 선택지를 함께 상의할 수 있어요.

english: Some medicines take several weeks to work fully.
transliteration: Yage ttara hyogwaga chungbunhi natanagikkaji myeot juga geollil su isseoyo.
translation: 약에 따라 효과가 충분히 나타나기까지 몇 주가 걸릴 수 있어요.

english: Please speak with your clinician before stopping medication.
transliteration: Yageul kkeunhgi jeone damdang uiryojingwa kkok sanguihae juseyo.
translation: 약을 끊기 전에 담당 의료진과 꼭 상의해 주세요.

english: Would you like us to involve a trusted family member?
transliteration: Mideul su inneun gajokbuneul hamkke chamyeosikigo sipeuseyo?
translation: 믿을 수 있는 가족분을 함께 참여시키고 싶으세요?

english: We can make a plan for what to do if symptoms worsen.
transliteration: Jeungsangi simhaejil ttae eotteoke halji hamkke gyehoegeul seul su isseoyo.
translation: 증상이 심해질 때 어떻게 할지 함께 계획을 세울 수 있어요.

english: What concerns do you have about treatment?
Do you feel safe going home today?
Who could you call if you felt unsafe?
transliteration: Anjeonhaji antago neukkisimyeon nuguege jeonhwahasil su innayo?
translation: 안전하지 않다고 느끼시면 누구에게 전화하실 수 있나요?

english: Can we identify warning signs that things are getting worse?
transliteration: Sangtaega nappajigo itdaneun sinhoreul hamkke hwaginhae bolkkayo?
translation: 상태가 나빠지고 있다는 신호를 함께 확인해 볼까요?

english: If you are in immediate danger, seek emergency help.
transliteration: Jigeum dangjang wiheomhan sanghwangiramyeon eunggeup doumeul badeuseyo.
translation: 지금 당장 위험한 상황이라면 응급 도움을 받으세요.

english: We can arrange a follow-up appointment.
transliteration: Chuhu jillyo yeyageul jabadeuril su isseoyo.
translation: 추후 진료 예약을 잡아드릴 수 있어요.

english: Would you like information about local support services?
transliteration: Jiyeogui jiwon seobiseue gwanhan jeongboreul badabosigesseoyo?
translation: 지역의 지원 서비스에 관한 정보를 받아보시겠어요?

english: Is there anything else you would like to ask?
I am going to ask some questions about your symptoms.
transliteration: Jeungsange daehae myeot gaji jilmun-eul deurilgeyo.
translation: 증상에 대해 몇 가지 질문을 드릴게요.

english: When did your symptoms first begin?
Did the symptoms start suddenly or gradually?
transliteration: Jeungsangi gapjagi sijakdwaennayo, animyeon seoseohi sijakdwaennayo?
translation: 증상이 갑자기 시작됐나요, 아니면 서서히 시작됐나요?

english: What were you doing when this started?
transliteration: Jeungsangi sijakdwaesseul ttae mueoseul hago gyesyeosseoyo?
translation: 증상이 시작됐을 때 무엇을 하고 계셨어요?

english: Are the symptoms constant or do they come and go?
transliteration: Jeungsangi gyesok innayo, animyeon saenggyeotda sarajyeotda hanayo?
translation: 증상이 계속 있나요, 아니면 생겼다 사라졌다 하나요?

english: How long does each episode last?
transliteration: Han beon jeungsangi saenggimyeon eolmana orae jisokdoenayo?
translation: 한 번 증상이 생기면 얼마나 오래 지속되나요?

english: How many times a day or week does this happen?
transliteration: Haruna iljuire myeot beon ireon iri saengginayo?
translation: 하루나 일주일에 몇 번 이런 일이 생기나요?

english: Are your symptoms getting better, worse, or staying the same?
transliteration: Jeungsangi naajigo innayo, simhaejigo innayo, animyeon geudaeroin-gayo?
translation: 증상이 나아지고 있나요, 심해지고 있나요, 아니면 그대로인가요?

english: Have you ever had this problem before?
transliteration: Jeone ireon munjega isseotdeon jeogi isseuseyo?
translation: 전에 이런 문제가 있었던 적이 있으세요?

english: Does anything make it better or worse?
transliteration: Jeungsangeul natge hageona deo simhage haneun geosi innayo?
translation: 증상을 낫게 하거나 더 심하게 하는 것이 있나요?

english: Please tell me immediately if you feel unwell during the examination.
transliteration: Geomsa junge momi an joeumyeon baro malsseumhae juseyo.
translation: 검사 중에 몸이 안 좋으면 바로 말씀해 주세요.

english: Did you suddenly develop weakness on one side of your body?
Did one side of your face suddenly droop?
Did you suddenly have trouble speaking?
Did you suddenly have trouble understanding speech?
Did you suddenly lose vision in one or both eyes?
transliteration: Hanjjok nunina yangjjok nunui siryeogeul gapjagi ireusyeonnayo?
translation: 한쪽 눈이나 양쪽 눈의 시력을 갑자기 잃으셨나요?

english: Did you suddenly lose your balance or coordination?
transliteration: Gapjagi gyunhyeongeul japgeona dongjageul jojeolhagi eoryeowojisyeonnayo?
translation: 갑자기 균형을 잡거나 동작을 조절하기 어려워지셨나요?

english: What time were you last completely well?
Did the symptoms go away completely?
Did you have the worst headache of your life?
Did the headache reach maximum intensity within seconds or a minute?
transliteration: Dutongi myeot chona il bun ane gajang simhaejyeonnayo?
translation: 두통이 몇 초나 1분 안에 가장 심해졌나요?

english: Do you have a fever with a stiff neck?
Have you had a new seizure or lost consciousness?
transliteration: Saero baljageul hageona uisigeul ireusin jeogi innayo?
translation: 새로 발작을 하거나 의식을 잃으신 적이 있나요?

english: Do you have new difficulty controlling your bladder or bowels?
Do you have numbness around your groin or buttocks?
transliteration: Satagunina eongdeongi jubyeoni jeorigeona gamgagi eomnayo?
translation: 사타구니나 엉덩이 주변이 저리거나 감각이 없나요?

english: Where exactly is your headache?
Is the pain on one side or both sides of your head?
transliteration: Meori hanjjogi apeungayo, yangjjogi da apeungayo?
translation: 머리 한쪽이 아픈가요, 양쪽이 다 아픈가요?

english: Does the pain spread to your neck, face, or behind your eyes?
transliteration: Tongjeungi mogina eolgul, ttoneun nun dwijjogeuro peojinayo?
translation: 통증이 목이나 얼굴, 또는 눈 뒤쪽으로 퍼지나요?

english: Is the pain throbbing, pressing, stabbing, or burning?
transliteration: Tongjeungi uksingeorinayo, nureuneun deuthangayo, jjireuneun deuthangayo, animyeon hwakkeungeorinayo?
translation: 통증이 욱신거리나요, 누르는 듯한가요, 찌르는 듯한가요, 아니면 화끈거리나요?

english: How severe is the pain from zero to ten?
transliteration: Tongjeungi yeong jeomeseo sip jeom jung myeot jeom jeongdoro simhangayo?
translation: 통증이 0점에서 10점 중 몇 점 정도로 심한가요?

english: Does light or noise bother you during the headache?
transliteration: Dutongi isseul ttae bichi-na soriga bulpyeonhage neukkyeojinayo?
translation: 두통이 있을 때 빛이나 소리가 불편하게 느껴지나요?

english: Do you feel nauseated or vomit with the headache?
Do you see flashing lights or zigzag lines before the headache?
transliteration: Dutongi ogi jeone beonjjeogineun bichina jigeujaegeu seoni bonayo?
translation: 두통이 오기 전에 번쩍이는 빛이나 지그재그 선이 보이나요?

english: Does physical activity make the headache worse?
Does coughing, straining, or bending make it worse?
transliteration: Gichihageona himeul jugeona momeul sukimyeon deo simhaejinayo?
translation: 기침하거나 힘을 주거나 몸을 숙이면 더 심해지나요?

english: Is the headache worse when lying down or standing up?
transliteration: Nuwo itgeona ireoseol ttae dutongi deo simhaejinayo?
translation: 누워 있거나 일어설 때 두통이 더 심해지나요?

english: Does the headache wake you from sleep?
Have your headaches changed recently?
How many days each month do you have a headache?
transliteration: Han dare myeochil jeongdo dutongi innayo?
translation: 한 달에 며칠 정도 두통이 있나요?

english: How often do you take painkillers for headaches?
transliteration: Dutong ttaemune jintongjereul eolmana jaju deusinayo?
translation: 두통 때문에 진통제를 얼마나 자주 드시나요?

english: Do you feel the room spinning or do you feel faint?
transliteration: Bangi bingbing doneun geot gatnayo, animyeon sseureojil geot gatnayo?
translation: 방이 빙빙 도는 것 같나요, 아니면 쓰러질 것 같나요?

english: Do you feel unsteady when walking?
Does turning your head trigger the dizziness?
Does standing up trigger the dizziness?
Does the dizziness last seconds, minutes, hours, or longer?
transliteration: Eojireomjeungi myeot cho, myeot bun, myeot sigan ttoneun geu isang jisokdoenayo?
translation: 어지럼증이 몇 초, 몇 분, 몇 시간 또는 그 이상 지속되나요?

english: Do you have ringing in your ears or hearing loss?
transliteration: Gwieseo ullineun soriga nageona cheongnyeogi tteoreojyeonnayo?
translation: 귀에서 울리는 소리가 나거나 청력이 떨어졌나요?

english: Have you fallen because of the dizziness?
Can you walk without assistance?
Do you feel weakness in your arms or legs?
Is one side weaker than the other?
Do you have trouble lifting your arms above your head?
transliteration: Pareul meori wiro deureo olligi eoryeopnayo?
translation: 팔을 머리 위로 들어 올리기 어렵나요?

english: Do you have trouble standing up from a chair?
Do you trip because your foot drags?
Do you drop objects from your hands?
Does the weakness get worse with repeated activity?
transliteration: Gateun dongjageul banbokhamyeon himi deo ppajinayo?
translation: 같은 동작을 반복하면 힘이 더 빠지나요?

english: Does resting improve the weakness?
Have you noticed muscle twitching or cramps?
transliteration: Geunyugi ssillukgeorigeona jwiga nan jeogi innayo?
translation: 근육이 씰룩거리거나 쥐가 난 적이 있나요?

english: Have your muscles become smaller over time?
Do you have numbness or tingling anywhere?
transliteration: Mom eodie jeorigeona jjiritan neukkimi innayo?
translation: 몸 어디에 저리거나 찌릿한 느낌이 있나요?

english: Where does the numbness begin and where does it spread?
transliteration: Jeorin neukkimi eodiseo sijakhaeseo eodikkaji peojinayo?
translation: 저린 느낌이 어디서 시작해서 어디까지 퍼지나요?

english: Is the numbness in both hands or both feet?
Do you feel burning or electric-shock-like pain?
transliteration: Taneun deuthageona jeongi chung-gyeok gateun tongjeungi innayo?
translation: 타는 듯하거나 전기 충격 같은 통증이 있나요?

english: Does the pain travel from your back down your leg?
Can you feel hot and cold normally?
transliteration: Tteugeoun geotgwa chagaun geoseul botongcheoreom neukkinayo?
translation: 뜨거운 것과 차가운 것을 보통처럼 느끼나요?

english: Does touching the skin cause unusual pain?
transliteration: Pibureul manjimyeon pyeongso-wa dareun tongjeungi innayo?
translation: 피부를 만지면 평소와 다른 통증이 있나요?

english: Have you ever had a seizure or fit?
Did anyone see what happened during the episode?
transliteration: Geuttae isseotdeon ireul bon sarami innayo?
translation: 그때 있었던 일을 본 사람이 있나요?

english: Did your arms or legs shake uncontrollably?
Did you lose awareness of your surroundings?
Did you bite your tongue?
Did you lose control of your bladder?
Were you confused or sleepy afterward?
Did you notice a strange smell, feeling, or warning before the episode?
transliteration: Geu iri ireonagi jeone isanghan naemsaena neukkimi deulgeona, miri allineun sinhoga isseonnayo?
translation: 그 일이 일어나기 전에 이상한 냄새나 느낌이 들거나, 미리 알리는 신호가 있었나요?

english: How long did it take to return to normal?
transliteration: Pyeongso sangtaero doraoneun de eolmana geollyeonnayo?
translation: 평소 상태로 돌아오는 데 얼마나 걸렸나요?

english: Have you missed any doses of your seizure medicine?
Do your hands shake when resting or when using them?
transliteration: Soneul gamanhi dugo isseul ttaena sayonghal ttae soni tteollinayo?
translation: 손을 가만히 두고 있을 때나 사용할 때 손이 떨리나요?

english: Does the shaking affect one hand or both?
transliteration: Tteollimi hanjjok sone-man innayo, yangsone innayo?
translation: 떨림이 한쪽 손에만 있나요, 양손에 있나요?

english: Has your handwriting become smaller?
Do you feel stiff or move more slowly?
Have you had difficulty starting to walk?
Do you freeze or feel stuck while walking?
transliteration: Geotdaga momi gutgeona bari tteoreojiji anneun neukkimi deunayo?
translation: 걷다가 몸이 굳거나 발이 떨어지지 않는 느낌이 드나요?

english: Have you noticed changes in your voice or facial expression?
Have you been forgetting recent conversations or appointments?
Do you have trouble finding the right words?
Have you become lost in familiar places?
transliteration: Iksukan goseseo gireul ireun jeogi innayo?
translation: 익숙한 곳에서 길을 잃은 적이 있나요?

english: Do you have difficulty managing medicines or finances?
Have you noticed changes in your mood or behaviour?
Do you have trouble concentrating?
Has your speech become slurred?
Do you have trouble swallowing food or liquids?
Do you see double?
Does the double vision go away when you cover one eye?
transliteration: Hanjjok nuneul garimyeon mulchega du gaero boineun jeungsangi sarajinayo?
translation: 한쪽 눈을 가리면 물체가 두 개로 보이는 증상이 사라지나요?

english: Have you noticed a drooping eyelid?
Do you have numbness or pain in your face?
Have you noticed weakness on one side of your face?
transliteration: Eolgul hanjjoge himi ppajin geoseul aracharyeonnayo?
translation: 얼굴 한쪽에 힘이 빠진 것을 알아차렸나요?

english: Have you noticed changes in your hearing?
Do you choke or cough when swallowing?
transliteration: Samkil ttae sarega deulligeona gichimh nayonayo?

english: Have you ever had a stroke or a mini-stroke?
transliteration: Noejoljungina ilgwas eong noeheohyeol baljageul gyeogeun jeogi innayo?
translation: 뇌졸중이나 일과성 뇌허혈 발작을 겪은 적이 있나요?

english: Have you ever had a head injury or concussion?
transliteration: Meorireul dachigeona noejintang-eul gyeogeun jeogi innayo?
translation: 머리를 다치거나 뇌진탕을 겪은 적이 있나요?

english: Have you ever had meningitis or a brain infection?
transliteration: Noesumangyeomina noe gamyeomeul gyeogeun jeogi innayo?
translation: 뇌수막염이나 뇌 감염을 겪은 적이 있나요?

english: Do you have diabetes, high blood pressure, or high cholesterol?
transliteration: Dangnyobyeong, gohyeorap ttoneun kolreseuterol suchiga nopeungayo?
translation: 당뇨병, 고혈압 또는 콜레스테롤 수치가 높은가요?

english: Does anyone in your family have migraines, seizures, or a neurological condition?
transliteration: Gajok junge pyeondutong, baljak ttoneun singyeonggye jilhwani inneun sarami innayo?
translation: 가족 중에 편두통, 발작 또는 신경계 질환이 있는 사람이 있나요?

english: What medicines do you take regularly?
What is the name and dose of your seizure medicine?
transliteration: Bogyonghasineun baljak yagui ireumgwa yongnyangi eotteoke doenayo?
translation: 복용하시는 발작 약의 이름과 용량이 어떻게 되나요?

english: How long have you been taking this medicine?
transliteration: I yageul bogyonghasin ji eolmana dwaennayo?
translation: 이 약을 복용하신 지 얼마나 됐나요?

english: Have you recently started, stopped, or changed a medicine?
transliteration: Choegune yageul saero sijakhageona kkeunkeona bakkwonnayo?
translation: 최근에 약을 새로 시작하거나 끊거나 바꿨나요?

english: Has this medicine helped your symptoms?
Have you noticed any side effects?
Do you drink alcohol or use recreational drugs?
transliteration: Sureul masigeona gibun jeonhwanyong yangmureul sayonghasinayo?
translation: 술을 마시거나 기분 전환용 약물을 사용하시나요?

english: Can you tell me your full name?
Can you tell me today's date?
Can you tell me where we are right now?
Please repeat these three words after me.
transliteration: Jega malhaneun se daneoreul ttara malsseumhae juseyo.
translation: 제가 말하는 세 단어를 따라 말씀해 주세요.

english: Please remember these words; I will ask you again later.
transliteration: I daneodeureul gieokhae duseyo. Najunge dasi yeojjwobolgeyo.
translation: 이 단어들을 기억해 두세요. 나중에 다시 여쭤볼게요.

english: Please name this object.
Please follow this two-step instruction.
transliteration: Du dangyero doen i jisireul ttara juseyo.
translation: 두 단계로 된 이 지시를 따라 주세요.

english: Please read this sentence aloud.
transliteration: I munjangeul sori naeeo ilgeo juseyo.
translation: 이 문장을 소리 내어 읽어 주세요.

english: Please write a complete sentence.
Please copy this drawing.
I am going to check your eye movements and facial muscles.
Please look straight ahead.
Follow my finger with your eyes without moving your head.
transliteration: Gogaereul umjigiji malgo nuneuro je songarageul ttarawa juseyo.
translation: 고개를 움직이지 말고 눈으로 제 손가락을 따라와 주세요.

english: Please cover one eye.
Tell me when you can see my moving finger.
transliteration: Jega umjigineun songaragi boimyeon malsseumhae juseyo.
translation: 제가 움직이는 손가락이 보이면 말씀해 주세요.

english: I am going to shine a light into your eyes.
Please raise your eyebrows.
Please close your eyes tightly.
Please smile and show your teeth.
Please puff out your cheeks.
Does this feel the same on both sides of your face?
Please open your mouth and say ah.
transliteration: Ibeul beolligo a sorireul nae juseyo.
translation: 입을 벌리고 아 소리를 내 주세요.

english: Please stick out your tongue.
Please shrug your shoulders against my hands.
transliteration: Je sone daego eokkaereul eusseukhae juseyo.
translation: 제 손에 대고 어깨를 으쓱해 주세요.

english: Please turn your head against my hand.
transliteration: Je sone daego gogaereul dollyeo juseyo.
translation: 제 손에 대고 고개를 돌려 주세요.

english: Please hold both arms straight out in front of you.
transliteration: Du pareul apeuro gotge ppeodeo juseyo.
translation: 두 팔을 앞으로 곧게 뻗어 주세요.

english: Turn your palms upward and close your eyes.
transliteration: Sonbadagi wiro hyanghage hago nuneul gama juseyo.
translation: 손바닥이 위로 향하게 하고 눈을 감아 주세요.

english: Please squeeze my fingers.
transliteration: Je songarageul kkwak jw ieo juseyo.

english: Please push against my hand.
Please pull against my hand.
Please lift your leg off the bed.
Please bend your knee.
Please straighten your knee.
Please pull your toes up toward your head.
transliteration: Balgara geul meori jjogeuro danggyeo juseyo.

english: Please push your foot down like pressing a pedal.
transliteration: Pedareul bapdeusi bareul araero nulleo juseyo.
translation: 페달을 밟듯이 발을 아래로 눌러 주세요.

english: Please relax while I move your arm.
transliteration: Jega pareul umjigineun dongan himeul ppae juseyo.
translation: 제가 팔을 움직이는 동안 힘을 빼 주세요.

english: Please close your eyes while I check your sensation.
transliteration: Gamag-eul hwaginhaneun dongan nuneul gama juseyo.
translation: 감각을 확인하는 동안 눈을 감아 주세요.

english: Can you feel me touching you here?
Does it feel the same on the left and right?
Tell me whether this feels sharp or dull.
transliteration: Ige nalkaropge neukkyeojineunji dunhage neukkyeojineunji malsseumhae juseyo.
translation: 이게 날카롭게 느껴지는지 둔하게 느껴지는지 말씀해 주세요.

english: Tell me whether this feels warm or cold.
transliteration: Ige ttatteuthage neukkyeojineunji chagapge neukkyeojineunji malsseumhae juseyo.
translation: 이게 따뜻하게 느껴지는지 차갑게 느껴지는지 말씀해 주세요.

english: Tell me which way I move your finger or toe.
transliteration: Jega songaragina balgarageul eoneu jjogeuro umjigineunji malsseumhae juseyo.
translation: 제가 손가락이나 발가락을 어느 쪽으로 움직이는지 말씀해 주세요.

english: I am going to tap your knee gently to check your reflexes.
Please let your arm or leg relax.
Please touch your nose and then my finger.
transliteration: Koreul manj in daeum je songarageul manjyeo juseyo.
translation: 코를 만진 다음 제 손가락을 만져 주세요.

english: Please do that again a little faster.
transliteration: Jogeum deo ppaleuge dasi hae juseyo.
translation: 조금 더 빠르게 다시 해 주세요.

english: Please tap your hands on your thighs, turning them over quickly.
transliteration: Heobeokji wieseo soneul ppaleuge dwijibeumyeonseo dudeuryeo juseyo.
translation: 허벅지 위에서 손을 빠르게 뒤집으면서 두드려 주세요.

english: Please slide your heel down your other shin.
transliteration: Baldwiggumchireul bandaejjok jeonggangireul ttara araero naeryeo juseyo.
translation: 발뒤꿈치를 반대쪽 정강이를 따라 아래로 내려 주세요.

english: Please stand with your feet together.
Please close your eyes while standing; I will stay beside you.
transliteration: Seoseo nuneul gama juseyo. Jega yeope isseulgeyo.
translation: 서서 눈을 감아 주세요. 제가 옆에 있을게요.

english: Please walk across the room and back.
Please walk heel to toe in a straight line.
transliteration: Dwiggumchigwa balkkeuteul butyeo iljjikseoneuro georeo juseyo.
translation: 뒤꿈치와 발끝을 붙여 일직선으로 걸어 주세요.

english: Please walk on your heels.
Please walk on your toes.
Please turn around and walk back.
We may need a CT scan of your head.
transliteration: Meori CT chwalyeongi piryohal sudo isseoyo.
translation: 머리 CT 촬영이 필요할 수도 있어요.

english: We may need an MRI scan of your brain or spine.
transliteration: Noena cheokchu MRI chwalyeongi piryohal sudo isseoyo.
translation: 뇌나 척추 MRI 촬영이 필요할 수도 있어요.

english: An EEG records the electrical activity of your brain.
transliteration: EEG-neun noee jeongi hwaldongeul girokhaneun geomsa-yeyo.
translation: EEG는 뇌의 전기 활동을 기록하는 검사예요.

english: A nerve conduction study checks how your nerves send signals.
transliteration: Singyeongjeondogeomsaneun singyeongi sinhoreul eotteoke jeondalhaneunji hwaginhaneun geomsa-yeyo.
translation: 신경전도검사는 신경이 신호를 어떻게 전달하는지 확인하는 검사예요.

english: A lumbar puncture takes a small sample of fluid from your lower back.
transliteration: Yochujeonjaneun heori araejjogeseo soryangui aekchereul chaechwihaneun geomsa-yeyo.
translation: 요추천자는 허리 아래쪽에서 소량의 액체를 채취하는 검사예요.

english: I will explain the benefits and risks before any procedure.
transliteration: Sisure jeone ijeomgwa wiheome daehae seolmyeonghae deurilgeyo.
translation: 시술 전에 이점과 위험에 대해 설명해 드릴게요.

english: Do you have any questions before we proceed?
We will discuss the results and next steps with you.
transliteration: Geomsa gyeolgwawa daeum dangyee daehae hamkke iyagihalgeyo.
translation: 검사 결과와 다음 단계에 대해 함께 이야기할게요.

english: Please take your medicines exactly as prescribed.
transliteration: Cheobangbadeun daero yageul jeonghwakhi bogyonghae juseyo.
translation: 처방받은 대로 약을 정확히 복용해 주세요.

english: Do not stop seizure medicines suddenly without medical advice.
transliteration: Uiryojingwa sanguihaji anko baljak yageul gapjagi kkeunji maseyo.
translation: 의료진과 상의하지 않고 발작 약을 갑자기 끊지 마세요.

english: Seek emergency care for sudden weakness, trouble speaking, or a severe sudden headache.
transliteration: Gapjagi himi ppajigeona, malhagi eoryeopgeona, gapjagi simhan dutongi saenggimyeon eunggeup jillyoreul badeuseyo.
translation: 갑자기 힘이 빠지거나, 말하기 어렵거나, 갑자기 심한 두통이 생기면 응급 진료를 받으세요.

english: We will arrange a follow-up appointment.
What questions do you have for me?
Hello. I am here to examine your eyes.
What brings you in today?
Please sit here.
Which eye is bothering you?
Is it one eye or both eyes?
When did the problem start?
May I examine your eyes?
Please tell me if anything hurts.
How long has this been happening?
How many days has this been happening?
Did it start suddenly or gradually?
Is it constant, or does it come and go?
transliteration: Gyesok innayo, animyeon saenggyeotda sarajyeotda hanayo?
translation: 계속 있나요, 아니면 생겼다 사라졌다 하나요?

english: How long does each episode last?
transliteration: Han beon jeungsangi saenggimyeon eolmana oraeganayo?
translation: 한 번 증상이 생기면 얼마나 오래가나요?

english: Does it last seconds, minutes, hours, or days?
transliteration: Myeot cho, myeot bun, myeot sigan, animyeon myeochil dongan jisokdoenayo?
translation: 몇 초, 몇 분, 몇 시간, 아니면 며칠 동안 지속되나요?

english: Is it getting better, worse, or staying the same?
transliteration: Naajigo innayo, simhaejigo innayo, animyeon geudaeroin gayo?
translation: 나아지고 있나요, 심해지고 있나요, 아니면 그대로인가요?

english: Has this happened before?
Did you wake up with this problem?
Did it start after an injury or procedure?
Has your vision changed?
Is your vision blurry?
Did you suddenly lose vision?
Did your vision return to normal?
Is your vision loss complete or partial?
Is the centre of your vision affected?
Is your side vision affected?
Is the top or bottom part of your vision missing?
Do you see flashes of light?
Do you see new floating spots or cobwebs?
transliteration: Saero saenggin tteodanineun jeomina geomijul gateun geosi boinayo?
translation: 새로 생긴 떠다니는 점이나 거미줄 같은 것이 보이나요?

english: Do you see a curtain or shadow over your vision?
transliteration: Siyae keoteunina geurimjaga deurieun geotcheoreom boinayo?
translation: 시야에 커튼이나 그림자가 드리운 것처럼 보이나요?

english: Do straight lines look bent or wavy?
Do you see two images of one object?
Does the double vision go away when you close either eye?
transliteration: Hanjjok nuneul gameumyeon gyeopchyeo boineun ge eopseojinayo?
translation: 한쪽 눈을 감으면 겹쳐 보이는 게 없어지나요?

english: Do you see halos around lights?
transliteration: Bulbit juwie teduri gateun geosi boinayo?
translation: 불빛 주위에 테두리 같은 것이 보이나요?

english: Is it harder to see at night?
Does bright light bother your eyes?
Do your eyes hurt?
Where exactly does it hurt? Please point.
transliteration: Jeonghwakhi eodiga apeungayo? Soneuro garikyeo juseyo.
translation: 정확히 어디가 아픈가요? 손으로 가리켜 주세요.

english: How severe is the pain from zero to ten?
transliteration: Tongjeungi yeongeseo sipkkaji junge eolmana simhangayo?

english: Is the pain sharp, dull, or burning?
transliteration: Tongjeungi nalkaroun gayo, dunhan gayo, animyeon taneun deuthangayo?
translation: 통증이 날카로운가요, 둔한가요, 아니면 타는 듯한가요?

english: Does the pain worsen when you move your eyes?
transliteration: Nuneul umjigil ttae tongjeungi deo simhaejinayo?
translation: 눈을 움직일 때 통증이 더 심해지나요?

english: Do you have a headache or nausea?
Are your eyes red?
Do your eyes itch?
Do your eyes feel dry or gritty?
transliteration: Nuni geonjohageona moraega deureogan geotcheoreom kkakkeulgeorinayo?
translation: 눈이 건조하거나 모래가 들어간 것처럼 까끌거리나요?

english: Are your eyes watering?
Is there sticky discharge or pus?
Are your eyelids swollen or drooping?
Do you have pain around, above, or below the eye?
Did anything hit or scratch your eye?
Did something get into your eye?
Did any chemical splash into your eye?
Have you rinsed your eye with water?
Do you wear contact lenses?
Do you sleep while wearing contact lenses?
When did you last wear your contact lenses?
Do you swim or shower with contact lenses in?
Have you recently started any new eye drops?
Do you wear glasses?
Have you recently changed your glasses prescription?
Have you had eye surgery or laser treatment?
transliteration: Nun sururina reijeo chiryoreul badeusin jeogi innayo?
translation: 눈 수술이나 레이저 치료를 받으신 적이 있나요?

english: Have you ever had this eye condition before?
transliteration: I nun jilhwaneul jeone alheusin jeogi innayo?
translation: 이 눈 질환을 전에 앓으신 적이 있나요?

english: Have you been told you have glaucoma (kala motia)?
Have you been told you have cataracts (chitta motia)?
Does anyone in your family have glaucoma?
transliteration: Gajok junge nongnaejangi inneun bumi innayo?
translation: 가족 중에 녹내장이 있는 분이 있나요?

english: Do you have diabetes or high blood pressure?
What medications or eye drops do you use?
Are you allergic to any medications?
When was your last eye examination?
transliteration: Majimageuro nun geomsareul badeusin ge eonjengayo?
translation: 마지막으로 눈 검사를 받으신 게 언제인가요?

english: Please show me which eye.
Look here.
Look straight ahead.
Open your eyes.
Close your eyes.
Keep both eyes open.
Put your glasses on.
Please remove your glasses.
Cover your left eye.
Cover your right eye.
Read the smallest line you can see.
transliteration: Boineun gajang jageun geulja jureul ilgeo boseyo.
translation: 보이는 가장 작은 글자 줄을 읽어 보세요.

english: Look through this small hole.
How many fingers do you see?
Can you see my hand moving?
Can you see the light?
I am going to shine a light into your eyes.
Please look at the wall behind me.
transliteration: Je dwie inneun byeogeul bwa juseyo.
translation: 제 뒤에 있는 벽을 봐 주세요.

english: Do not look directly at the light.
Look at my finger without moving your head.
transliteration: Meorireul umjigiji malgo je songarageul boseyo.
translation: 머리를 움직이지 말고 제 손가락을 보세요.

english: Look up.
Look down.
Look left.
Look right.
Is the double vision worse in this direction?
transliteration: Ijjogeul bol ttae samuri du gaero boineun jeungsangi deo simhangayo?
translation: 이쪽을 볼 때 사물이 두 개로 보이는 증상이 더 심한가요?

english: Raise your eyebrows.
Keep looking at my nose, not my hand.
transliteration: Je soni anira je koreul gyesok boseyo.
translation: 제 손이 아니라 제 코를 계속 보세요.

english: Raise your hand when you see my fingers.
transliteration: Je songaragi boimyeon soneul deureo juseyo.
translation: 제 손가락이 보이면 손을 들어 주세요.

english: Tell me when you see the light.
Do you see the same on both sides?
I am going to check the pressure in your eye.
You may feel a light touch on your eye.
transliteration: Nune saljjak danneun neukkimi deul su isseoyo.
translation: 눈에 살짝 닿는 느낌이 들 수 있어요.

english: Please keep still and try not to blink.
transliteration: Gamanhi gyesigo nuneul kkamppagiji antorok hae juseyo.
translation: 가만히 계시고 눈을 깜빡이지 않도록 해 주세요.

english: Place your chin here and your forehead against the bar.
transliteration: Teogeul yeogie daego imareul makdaee dae juseyo.
translation: 턱을 여기에 대고 이마를 막대에 대 주세요.

english: Open your eyes wide.
Please do not pull your head back.
The light will be bright.
I am going to touch your eyelid.
Look at my ear.
I am going to put drops in your eyes.
These drops will numb your eye and may sting briefly.
transliteration: I anyageun nuneul machwisikigo jamkkan ttakkeumgeoril su isseoyo.
translation: 이 안약은 눈을 마취시키고 잠깐 따끔거릴 수 있어요.

english: These drops will make your pupils bigger.
transliteration: I anyageun donggongeul keuge mandeul geoyeyo.
translation: 이 안약은 동공을 크게 만들 거예요.

english: Your vision may be blurry for several hours.
transliteration: Myeot sigan dongan siyaga heuril su isseoyo.
translation: 몇 시간 동안 시야가 흐릴 수 있어요.

english: Bright light may bother you after the drops.
transliteration: Anyageul neoeun dwie balgeun bichi bulpyeonhal su isseoyo.
translation: 안약을 넣은 뒤에 밝은 빛이 불편할 수 있어요.

english: Please do not rub your eyes.
Please remove your contact lenses.
We are going to take photographs of the back of your eye.
We are going to do a scan of the back of your eye.
Have you had an eye ultrasound before?
transliteration: Jeone nun choeumpa geomsareul badeusin jeogi innayo?
translation: 전에 눈 초음파 검사를 받으신 적이 있나요?

english: Have you had an MRI scan of your eyes or head?
transliteration: Nunina meori MRI geomsareul badeusin jeogi innayo?
translation: 눈이나 머리 MRI 검사를 받으신 적이 있나요?

english: You will lie still inside a noisy scanner.
transliteration: Soriga keun seukaeneo ane gamanhi nuwo gesil geoyeyo.
translation: 소리가 큰 스캐너 안에 가만히 누워 계실 거예요.

english: Please follow the light with your eyes.
The examination is finished. Thank you.
We need to arrange an appointment with an eye specialist.
transliteration: Angwa jeonmunui jillyo yeyageul jabaya haeyo.
translation: 안과 전문의 진료 예약을 잡아야 해요.

english: I need to discuss your examination with another doctor.
transliteration: Geomsa gyeolgwareul dareun uisawa sanguihaeya haeyo.
translation: 검사 결과를 다른 의사와 상의해야 해요.

english: We will use a professional interpreter to explain your results.
transliteration: Jeonmun tongyeoksawa hamkke geomsa gyeolgwareul seolmyeonghae deurilgeyo.
translation: 전문 통역사와 함께 검사 결과를 설명해 드릴게요.

english: If your vision suddenly worsens, seek urgent medical care.
transliteration: Siryeogi gapjagi nappajimyeon geuphi jillyoreul badeuseyo.
translation: 시력이 갑자기 나빠지면 급히 진료를 받으세요.

english: Do you have any questions?
Hello, I am here to examine your ears, nose and throat.
transliteration: Annyeonghaseyo. Gwi, ko, mogeul jinchalhareo wasseoyo.
translation: 안녕하세요. 귀, 코, 목을 진찰하러 왔어요.

english: What problem brought you here today?
Please point to where you feel the problem.
Is it on the right, left, or both sides?
When did this start?
Did it start suddenly or gradually?
How long has it been happening: hours, days, weeks, or months?
transliteration: Myeot sigan, myeochil, myeot ju ttoneun myeot dal dongan gyesokdwaennayo?
translation: 몇 시간, 며칠, 몇 주 또는 몇 달 동안 계속됐나요?

english: Is it getting better, worse, or staying the same?
transliteration: Naajigo innayo, deo simhaejigo innayo, animyeon geudaeroingayo?
translation: 나아지고 있나요, 더 심해지고 있나요, 아니면 그대로인가요?

english: Have you had this problem before?
Are you having trouble breathing or swallowing your saliva?
Are you having trouble hearing?
Which ear is affected?
Did your hearing change suddenly?
When was your hearing last normal?
Is your hearing loss constant or does it come and go?
transliteration: Cheongnyeogi gyesok nappeungayo, animyeon gwaenchanajyeotdaga nappeojigireul banbokhanayo?
translation: 청력이 계속 나쁜가요, 아니면 괜찮아졌다가 나빠지기를 반복하나요?

english: Do you have trouble understanding speech, especially in noisy places?
transliteration: Teukhi sikkeureoun goseseo dareun saramui mareul aradeutgi eoryeusinayo?
translation: 특히 시끄러운 곳에서 다른 사람의 말을 알아듣기 어려우신가요?

english: Do you use hearing aids?
Have you had a hearing test before?
transliteration: Jeone cheongnyeok geomsareul bada bosin jeogi innayo?
translation: 전에 청력 검사를 받아 보신 적이 있나요?

english: Have you been exposed to loud noise recently or at work?
transliteration: Choegunina jikjangeseo keun soeume nochuldoen jeogi innayo?
translation: 최근이나 직장에서 큰 소음에 노출된 적이 있나요?

english: Do you hear ringing, buzzing, or other sounds in your ears?
transliteration: Gwieseo ppi sorina wingwinggeorineun sori ttoneun dareun soriga deullinayo?
translation: 귀에서 삐 소리나 윙윙거리는 소리 또는 다른 소리가 들리나요?

english: Is the sound in one ear or both ears?
transliteration: Hanjjok gwieseo deullinayo, yangjjok gwieseo deullinayo?
translation: 한쪽 귀에서 들리나요, 양쪽 귀에서 들리나요?

english: Is the sound constant or intermittent?
transliteration: Soriga gyesok deullinayo, animyeon deullyeotda an deullyeotda hanayo?
translation: 소리가 계속 들리나요, 아니면 들렸다 안 들렸다 하나요?

english: Does the sound beat in time with your heartbeat?
Does the sound affect your sleep or daily activities?
transliteration: Geu sori ttaemune jameul jagena ilsangsaenghwareul haneun de jijangi innayo?
translation: 그 소리 때문에 잠을 자거나 일상생활을 하는 데 지장이 있나요?

english: Does your ear feel blocked or under pressure?
transliteration: Gwiga makhin geot gatgeona appakgami deunayo?
translation: 귀가 막힌 것 같거나 압박감이 드나요?

english: Does swallowing or yawning change the pressure?
Do you have ear pain?
Does it hurt when you touch or pull your outer ear?
Is fluid or pus coming out of your ear?
What colour is the discharge?
Have you noticed blood coming from your ear?
Do you have fever or swelling behind your ear?
Have you recently been swimming or gotten water in your ear?
transliteration: Choegune suyeongeul hasyeotgeona gwie muri deureogan jeogi innayo?
translation: 최근에 수영을 하셨거나 귀에 물이 들어간 적이 있나요?

english: Do you use cotton swabs to clean your ears?
Did anything get stuck in your ear?
transliteration: Gwie mwonga deureogaseo ppajiji aneun jeogi innayo?
translation: 귀에 뭔가 들어가서 빠지지 않은 적이 있나요?

english: Have you had an injury or blow to your ear or head?
transliteration: Choegune gwina meorireul dachigeona budichin jeogi innayo?
translation: 최근에 귀나 머리를 다치거나 부딪힌 적이 있나요?

english: Do you feel dizzy or unsteady?
Does it feel as though you or the room is spinning?
transliteration: Boninina bangi bingbing doneun geotcheoreom neukkyeojinayo?
translation: 본인이나 방이 빙빙 도는 것처럼 느껴지나요?

english: How long does each episode last?
transliteration: Eojireoun jeungsangi han beon saenggimyeon eolmana oraeganayo?
translation: 어지러운 증상이 한 번 생기면 얼마나 오래가나요?

english: Does turning your head or rolling over in bed trigger it?
transliteration: Gogaereul dolligeona chimdaeseo momeul dwicheogimyeon eojireowojinayo?
translation: 고개를 돌리거나 침대에서 몸을 뒤척이면 어지러워지나요?

english: Do you have nausea or vomiting with the dizziness?
Do you also notice hearing loss, ringing, or ear fullness?
transliteration: Cheongnyeok jeoha, gwiullim, gwiga kkwak chan neukkimdo innayo?
translation: 청력 저하, 귀울림, 귀가 꽉 찬 느낌도 있나요?

english: Have you fainted, had weakness, double vision, or trouble speaking?
transliteration: Silsinhageona himi ppajin jeogi innayo? Mulchega du gaero boigeona malhagi eoryeoun jeogeunyo?
translation: 실신하거나 힘이 빠진 적이 있나요? 물체가 두 개로 보이거나 말하기 어려운 적은요?

english: Is your nose blocked or stuffy?
Is one nostril blocked or both?
Do you have a runny nose?
What colour is the mucus?
Do you have pain or pressure in your cheeks or forehead?
Does mucus drip down the back of your throat?
Have you lost or noticed a change in your sense of smell?
transliteration: Hugageul ireotgeona hugage byeonhwaga saenggin geoseul aracharisyeonnayo?
translation: 후각을 잃었거나 후각에 변화가 생긴 것을 알아차리셨나요?

english: Do you sneeze or have itchy, watery eyes?
transliteration: Jaechagiga nageona nuni gareopgo nunmuri nanayo?
translation: 재채기가 나거나 눈이 가렵고 눈물이 나나요?

english: Do you get sinus infections repeatedly?
Have you had a recent cold or allergy symptoms?
transliteration: Choegune gamgie geollyeotgeona allereugi jeungsangi isseonnayo?
translation: 최근에 감기에 걸렸거나 알레르기 증상이 있었나요?

english: Have you had a nosebleed?
Which nostril is bleeding?
How long does the bleeding usually last?
Is the bleeding heavy or difficult to stop?
transliteration: Piga mani nageona jal meomchuji annayo?
translation: 피가 많이 나거나 잘 멈추지 않나요?

english: Have you injured your nose recently?
Are you taking blood thinners?
Do you pick your nose or use nasal sprays?
Do you have a sore throat?
Is swallowing painful?
Is it difficult to swallow solids, liquids, or both?
transliteration: Gohyeong eumsigina aekche ttoneun dul da samkigi eoryeusinayo?
translation: 고형 음식이나 액체 또는 둘 다 삼키기 어려우신가요?

english: Does food feel stuck in your throat?
Do you cough or choke when eating or drinking?
transliteration: Meokgeona masil ttae gichimhageona sarega deunayo?
translation: 먹거나 마실 때 기침하거나 사레가 드나요?

english: Can you swallow your saliva?
Do you have fever, swollen tonsils, or white patches in your throat?
transliteration: Yeori nageona pyeondoga buwonnayo? Moge huin banjeomi innayo?
translation: 열이 나거나 편도가 부었나요? 목에 흰 반점이 있나요?

english: Have you had repeated tonsil infections?
Do you feel a lump or something stuck in your throat?
transliteration: Moge hogi itgeona mwonga geollin geotcheoreom neukkyeojinayo?
translation: 목에 혹이 있거나 뭔가 걸린 것처럼 느껴지나요?

english: Has your voice become hoarse or changed?
How long has your voice been different?
Have you completely lost your voice?
Do you have noisy breathing or difficulty breathing?
transliteration: Sum swil ttae geochin soriga nageona sumswigi eoryeusinayo?
translation: 숨 쉴 때 거친 소리가 나거나 숨쉬기 어려우신가요?

english: Do you snore loudly?
Has anyone noticed you stop breathing during sleep?
transliteration: Janeun dongan sumeul meomchundago nuga malhan jeogi innayo?
translation: 자는 동안 숨을 멈춘다고 누가 말한 적이 있나요?

english: Do you feel sleepy during the day?
Do you have persistent cough or acid reflux?
transliteration: Gichimi gyesok nageona wisan yeongnyuga innayo?
translation: 기침이 계속 나거나 위산 역류가 있나요?

english: Do you have pain or sores in your mouth?
Do you have white or red patches in your mouth?
Do you have trouble opening your mouth?
Do you have jaw pain or pain in front of your ear?
Does your jaw click or lock?
transliteration: Teogeseo ttak soriga nageona teogi jamginayo?
translation: 턱에서 딱 소리가 나거나 턱이 잠기나요?

english: Does your mouth feel unusually dry?
Do you have swelling under your jaw or near your ear?
Does the swelling or pain worsen when you eat?
transliteration: Meogeul ttae butgeona apeun jeungsangi deo simhaejinayo?
translation: 먹을 때 붓거나 아픈 증상이 더 심해지나요?

english: Have you noticed a change in your sense of taste?
Have you noticed a lump or swelling in your neck?
transliteration: Moge hogi manjyeojigeona bueun gosi innayo?
translation: 목에 혹이 만져지거나 부은 곳이 있나요?

english: How long has the lump been there?
transliteration: Geu hogi saenggin ji eolmana dwaennayo?
translation: 그 혹이 생긴 지 얼마나 됐나요?

english: Is the lump growing or painful?
Have you had unexplained weight loss or night sweats?
transliteration: Iyu eopsi chejung-i julleona bame sigeunttami nanayo?
translation: 이유 없이 체중이 줄거나 밤에 식은땀이 나나요?

english: Do you have persistent one-sided throat or ear pain?
Have you coughed up blood?
transliteration: Gichimhal ttae piga naon jeogi innayo?
translation: 기침할 때 피가 나온 적이 있나요?

english: Do you smoke, vape, or use chewing tobacco?
transliteration: Dambaereul piugeona jeonjadambae ttoneun ssipneun dambaereul sayonghasinayo?
translation: 담배를 피우거나 전자담배 또는 씹는 담배를 사용하시나요?

english: Do you drink alcohol?
Have you had ear, nose, or throat surgery?
transliteration: Gwi, ko, mok susureul badeun jeogi innayo?
translation: 귀, 코, 목 수술을 받은 적이 있나요?

english: Have you had ear infections or a perforated eardrum before?
transliteration: Jeone gwie yeomjeungi saenggigeona gomagi ttullin jeogi innayo?
translation: 전에 귀에 염증이 생기거나 고막이 뚫린 적이 있나요?

english: Have you had your tonsils or adenoids removed?
Have you had a CT scan, MRI, or hearing test?
transliteration: CT geomsa, MRI geomsa ttoneun cheongnyeok geomsareul bad-eusin jeogi innayo?
translation: CT 검사, MRI 검사 또는 청력 검사를 받으신 적이 있나요?

english: What medications, drops, or sprays have you tried?
transliteration: Eotteon yagina gwiyak, ko seupeureireul sayonghae bosyeonnayo?
translation: 어떤 약이나 귀약, 코 스프레이를 사용해 보셨나요?

english: How often and for how long have you used them?
Did the treatment help?
Are you allergic to any medications?
Is there a family history of hearing loss or head and neck cancer?
transliteration: Gajok junge cheongnyeok jeohana dugyeongbuami isseonnayo?
translation: 가족 중에 청력 저하나 두경부암이 있었나요?

english: Please sit still. I am going to look inside your ear.
transliteration: Umjigiji malgo anja juseyo. Gwi aneul salpyeobolgeyo.
translation: 움직이지 말고 앉아 주세요. 귀 안을 살펴볼게요.

english: Please remove your hearing aid.
I will gently pull your ear to see inside.
transliteration: Anjjogeul bol su itge gwireul saljjak danggilgeyo.
translation: 안쪽을 볼 수 있게 귀를 살짝 당길게요.

english: Tell me if this hurts.
I am going to check your hearing.
Cover one ear and repeat the words you hear.
transliteration: Hanjjok gwireul makgo deullineun daneoreul ttara malhae juseyo.
translation: 한쪽 귀를 막고 들리는 단어를 따라 말해 주세요.

english: Tell me whether you hear the tuning fork on the left, right, or in the middle.
transliteration: Sorigupsoe soriga oenjjok, oreunjjok, gaunde jung eodieseo deullineunji malsseumhae juseyo.
translation: 소리굽쇠 소리가 왼쪽, 오른쪽, 가운데 중 어디에서 들리는지 말씀해 주세요.

english: Tell me when you can no longer hear the sound.
transliteration: Soriga deo isang deulliji aneumyeon malsseumhae juseyo.
translation: 소리가 더 이상 들리지 않으면 말씀해 주세요.

english: I am going to examine your eardrum.
I am going to examine your nose.
Please breathe through your nose.
Close one nostril and breathe through the other.
transliteration: Hanjjok kotgumeongeul makgo dareun jjogeuro sum swieo boseyo.
translation: 한쪽 콧구멍을 막고 다른 쪽으로 숨 쉬어 보세요.

english: Open your mouth wide, please.
Stick out your tongue, please.
Say “ah,” please.
Move your tongue from side to side.
I am going to feel your neck for any lumps.
Please swallow once.
Turn your head to the left, then to the right.
transliteration: Meorireul oenjjogeuro dollin daeum oreunjjogeuro dollyeo boseyo.
translation: 머리를 왼쪽으로 돌린 다음 오른쪽으로 돌려 보세요.

english: We may need a formal hearing test.
transliteration: Jeongsik cheongnyeok geomsa-ga piryohal sudo isseoyo.
translation: 정식 청력 검사가 필요할 수도 있어요.

english: We may need a camera examination of your nose or throat.
transliteration: Kona mog aneul kamera-ro salpyeobwaya hal sudo isseoyo.
translation: 코나 목 안을 카메라로 살펴봐야 할 수도 있어요.

english: I will gently pass a small flexible camera through your nose.
transliteration: Jakgo yuyeonhan kamera-reul koro budeureopge neoeulgeyo.
translation: 작고 유연한 카메라를 코로 부드럽게 넣을게요.

english: You may feel pressure or discomfort, but tell me if it is painful.
transliteration: Apbakgam-ina bulpyeonham-i neukkyeojil su itjiman, apeumyeon malsseumhae juseyo.
translation: 압박감이나 불편함이 느껴질 수 있지만, 아프면 말씀해 주세요.

english: We may need a CT scan or MRI to look more closely.
transliteration: Jasehi salpyeobogi wihae CT chwaryeong-ina MRI geomsa-ga piryohal sudo isseoyo.
translation: 자세히 살펴보기 위해 CT 촬영이나 MRI 검사가 필요할 수도 있어요.

english: We may need to take a small sample of tissue for testing.
transliteration: Geomsareul wihae jojigeul jogeum tteeonaeya hal sudo isseoyo.
translation: 검사를 위해 조직을 조금 떼어내야 할 수도 있어요.

english: I am going to remove some earwax if it is safe to do so.
Please use the medicine exactly as prescribed.
I will prescribe ear drops or a nasal spray if needed.
transliteration: Piryohamyeon gwiyak-ina ko seupeureireul cheobanghae deurilgeyo.
translation: 필요하면 귀약이나 코 스프레이를 처방해 드릴게요.

english: Keep your ear dry until we tell you otherwise.
transliteration: Dareun annaereul deuril ttaekkaji gwie muri deureogaji anke hae juseyo.
translation: 다른 안내를 드릴 때까지 귀에 물이 들어가지 않게 해 주세요.

english: Do not put cotton swabs or other objects inside your ear.
transliteration: Myeonbong-ina dareun mulgeoneul gwi ane neotji maseyo.
translation: 면봉이나 다른 물건을 귀 안에 넣지 마세요.

english: If you have sudden hearing loss, seek urgent medical care.
transliteration: Gapjagi cheongnyeogi tteoreojimyeon geuphi jinryoreul badeuseyo.
translation: 갑자기 청력이 떨어지면 급히 진료를 받으세요.

english: If you have severe trouble breathing or cannot swallow saliva, seek emergency care.
transliteration: Sumswigiga simhage eoryeopgeona chimeul samkil su eopseumyeon eunggeup jinryoreul badeuseyo.
translation: 숨쉬기가 심하게 어렵거나 침을 삼킬 수 없으면 응급 진료를 받으세요.

english: We will arrange an appointment with an ENT specialist.
We will use a professional interpreter to discuss results and treatment.
transliteration: Gyeolgwa-wa chiryo-e daehae iyagihal ttae jeonmun tongyeoksareul iyonghalgeyo.
translation: 결과와 치료에 대해 이야기할 때 전문 통역사를 이용할게요.

english: The examination is finished. Thank you.
I am going to examine your skin.
What brings you in today?
Please show me the affected area.
May I examine this area?
Is it okay if I take a photograph for your medical record?
transliteration: Jillyo giroge namgil sajineul jjigeodo gwaenchaneulkkayo?
translation: 진료 기록에 남길 사진을 찍어도 괜찮을까요?

english: When did you first notice this skin problem?
transliteration: I pibu munjega cheoeum saenggin geoseul eonje aracharisyeonnayo?
translation: 이 피부 문제가 처음 생긴 것을 언제 알아차리셨나요?

english: How long have you had it?
Did it appear suddenly or gradually?
Where did it first appear?
Has it spread to other areas?
Is it getting better, worse, or staying the same?
